verdict.rationale: three.js is a client-side, MIT-licensed JavaScript 3D rendering library installed via npm. It is not a hosted service that collects or holds user data, so an AI-training opt-out is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it running any data-collecting service that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
